Validate a provenance receipt

Source: R/crt_receipt_read.R
crt_receipt_validate.Rd

Checks a receipt against the receipt JSON Schema installed with crate, then recomputes its recipe_id, which the schema cannot check.

Usage

crt_receipt_validate(x, error = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A receipt, as a list from crt_receipt_read(), or a path to one.

error

If TRUE (the default), abort on an invalid receipt, listing what is wrong; if FALSE, return FALSE with the problems as attribute errors.

Value

TRUE, invisibly, for a valid receipt.

Requires

the jsonvalidate package.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("jsonvalidate", quietly = TRUE)) {
  crt_receipt_validate(system.file("extdata", "receipt", "examples", "worked_case",
                                   "build_1", package = "crate"))
}
